description: This is an HTML source file for a web-based database viewer interface. It defines the structure, style, and client-side scripting for browsing multiple databases, viewing tables, and displaying table data dynamically.
external_methods: fetchData (JavaScript fetch wrapper for API calls)
published: None (client-side only, no explicit export or module symbols)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of databases from the server.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets selections, and updates UI.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data for a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML for the data table from JSON data.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual table cell content based on data type.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses table cell content for long or object data.
